title: Star of David: Copy & Paste ✡ — How a Shared Hexagram Became a Jewish Symbol
meta_description: Copy and paste the Star of David (✡) and learn its layered history — from an ancient geometric motif shared across cultures to the emblem of Judaism. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: The six-pointed Star of David (✡ ✡️) — the Magen David, or "Shield of David" — whose path to becoming the emblem of Judaism is more recent and more layered than most people assume. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: The Star of David (✡, U+2721) — Magen David, "Shield of David" in Hebrew — is the six-pointed star recognized today as the symbol of Judaism and the emblem at the center of the flag of Israel. Yet the hexagram itself is far older and far more widely shared than that role suggests: for most of its history it was a common geometric motif used across many cultures, and its journey to becoming a distinctly Jewish sign is a comparatively recent, well-documented story.
